installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper+Floodgate Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e
cd /mnt/server

# Shared Paper / GeyserMC helpers for egg install scripts.

PROJECT=paper
USER_AGENT="Pterodactyl (https://Pterodactyl.io)"

require_jq() {
	if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		echo "jq is required but not available"
		return 1
	fi
	JQ=jq
}

resolve_paper_download() {
	require_jq || return 1

	if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
		echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
		DOWNLOAD_URL=$(eval echo "$(echo "${DL_PATH}" | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')")
		return 0
	fi

	VER_EXISTS=$("${JQ}" -r --arg VERSION "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '.versions | any(.[]; index($VERSION))' <<<"$(curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}")" | grep -m1 true || true)
	LATEST_VERSION=$("${JQ}" -r '.versions | to_entries | .[0].value[0]' <<<"$(curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}")")

	if [ "${VER_EXISTS}" = "true" ]; then
		echo -e "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
		RESOLVED_MC_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	else
		echo -e "Specified version not found. Defaulting to the latest ${PROJECT} version"
		RESOLVED_MC_VERSION="${LATEST_VERSION}"
	fi

	VERSION_JSON=$(curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${RESOLVED_MC_VERSION}")
	LATEST_BUILD=$("${JQ}" -r '.builds | .[0]' <<<"${VERSION_JSON}")

	if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ]; then
		RESOLVED_BUILD="${LATEST_BUILD}"
		echo -e "Using the latest ${PROJECT} build for version ${RESOLVED_MC_VERSION}"
	else
		BUILD_EXISTS=$("${JQ}" -r --arg BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds[] | tostring | contains($BUILD)' <<<"${VERSION_JSON}" | grep -m1 true || true)
		if [ "${BUILD_EXISTS}" = "true" ]; then
			echo -e "Build is valid for version ${RESOLVED_MC_VERSION}. Using build ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
			RESOLVED_BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER}"
		else
			echo -e "Using the latest ${PROJECT} build for version ${RESOLVED_MC_VERSION}"
			RESOLVED_BUILD="${LATEST_BUILD}"
		fi
	fi

	echo "Version being downloaded"
	echo -e "Project: ${PROJECT}"
	echo -e "MC Version: ${RESOLVED_MC_VERSION}"
	echo -e "Build: ${RESOLVED_BUILD}"

	DOWNLOAD_URL=$("${JQ}" -r '.downloads."server:default".url' <<<"$(curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${RESOLVED_MC_VERSION}/builds/${RESOLVED_BUILD}")")
}

download_paper_jar() {
	resolve_paper_download || return 1

	echo -e "Running curl --user-agent \"${USER_AGENT}\" -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

	if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
		mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
	fi

	curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -fsSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || return 1
}

download_server_properties() {
	if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
		echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
		curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -fsSL -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
	fi
}

download_geyser_plugin() {
	require_jq || return 1
	mkdir -p plugins

	GEYSER_META=$(curl -fsSL https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/geyser/versions/latest/builds/latest)
	GEYSER_HASH=$("${JQ}" -r '.downloads.spigot.sha256' <<<"${GEYSER_META}")

	echo -e "Downloading Geyser"
	curl -fsSL -o plugins/geyser-spigot.jar https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/geyser/versions/latest/builds/latest/downloads/spigot
	echo "${GEYSER_HASH} plugins/geyser-spigot.jar" | sha256sum -c || {
		echo "Geyser SHA256 does not match! Aborting..."
		rm -f plugins/geyser-spigot.jar
		return 1
	}
	echo "Geyser SHA256 match"
}

download_floodgate_plugin() {
	require_jq || return 1
	mkdir -p plugins

	FLOODGATE_META=$(curl -fsSL https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/floodgate/versions/latest/builds/latest)
	FLOODGATE_HASH=$("${JQ}" -r '.downloads.spigot.sha256' <<<"${FLOODGATE_META}")

	echo -e "Downloading Floodgate"
	curl -fsSL -o plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/floodgate/versions/latest/builds/latest/downloads/spigot
	echo "${FLOODGATE_HASH} plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar" | sha256sum -c || {
		echo "Floodgate SHA256 does not match! Aborting..."
		rm -f plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar
		return 1
	}
	echo "Floodgate SHA256 match"
}

install_geyser_config() {
	mkdir -p plugins/Geyser-Spigot/
	if [ ! -f "plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml" ]; then
		echo -e "Downloading default Geyser config"
		curl -fsSL -o plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GeyserMC/Geyser/master/core/src/main/resources/config.yml
		sed -i 's/: online/: floodgate/g' plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml
	fi
}

download_paper_jar || exit 1
download_server_properties
mkdir -p plugins
download_floodgate_plugin || exit 1
echo "Installation complete"
